findings.explanation: Functions like strcpy(), strcat(), sprintf(), and vsprintf() perform unbounded memory writes without checking destination buffer capacity. findings.explanation: Invoking child_process.exec(), execSync(), or spawn() with shell: true using concatenated strings or tainted parameters permits command injection. Attackers can append shell metacharacters (&, |, ;) to run unauthorized commands.
findings.label: MALICIOUS

findings.title: Command Injection via child_process Execution

findings.explanation: Java processes \uXXXX escapes prior to parsing. Injecting bidi controls (e.g. \u202E) or zero-width characters inside comments or code alters visual reading order while executing differently in the JVM (CVE-2021-42574).
findings.label: MALICIOUS
findings.message: Trojan Source bidi/control character injected via Unicode escape \u202E.
findings.title: Trojan Source / Dangerous Unicode Escape in Java Source
